config.name: Great North Walk
config.description: From the obelisk in Macquarie Place, Sydney, to Queens Wharf, Newcastle, through the Lane Cove valley, Berowra, the Hawkesbury, the Watagan Mountains and Lake Macquarie. Two water crossings are route breaks here: the harbour ferries from Circular Quay to Woolwich, and the Hawkesbury from Brooklyn to Patonga. The Pokolbin spur is carried as a side trip.
